title: UFOs never discussed at the top of NSA and ODNI
summary: Eric Haseltine tells of UFOs never discussed at the top of NSA and ODNI, about 2000s at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
No. And I'll tell you that inside the
highest levels of the intelligence
community, this is not something we
spent a fth second thinking about

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the NSA, the US spy agency that intercepts communications, and at the ODNI, the office that oversees all US spy agencies, says UFOs never came up at the top of those agencies in the 2000s. In his words, nobody there spent a fifth of a second thinking about them. If true, any secret UFO work was kept away from even the most senior intelligence leaders, or did not exist there.
